compute.firewalls.list: To list the firewall rules of the host network, so the connectivity an exocompute cluster needs can be checked.
compute.networks.list: To list the shared VPC networks a customer can run exocompute on.
compute.subnetworks.use: To use a subnet of the host network for the exocompute cluster.
compute.subnetworks.useExternalIp: To use an external address on that subnet, so the cluster can reach services outside the network.
